claims.claim_vi: The source names eight scalability strategies: stateless services, horizontal scaling, load balancing, auto scaling, caching, database replication, database sharding, async processing.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; only the names and order are used.

claims.claim_vi: Each strategy removes a different bottleneck and has its own cost (e.g. single-leader (primary plus read replicas) replication does not speed up writes, while clusters with several write nodes differ; auto scaling reacts after the load; caching can serve stale data).
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung bốn ghi chú: tầng ứng dụng và tầng dữ liệu cùng công việc.
source_deviations: Source is a list of eight items; the lesson keeps the names and order and rewrites each as what it removes and what it costs.
The lesson splits the eight into two halves to show which part of the system each touches.
